info.description: Returns up-to-date fund-raising activity data in JSON or XML. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version. Authentication requirements are not documented.
info.title: Approved Fund-Raising Activities API

get.description: Searches fund-raising activities. If either fromdate or todate is omitted, today's activity is returned. If activity, licence, or charitable is omitted, no filter is applied for that criterion. Defaults: orderby=date, orderstyle=desc, itemperpage=10, and page=1. A requested itemperpage greater than 100 yields at most 100 records per request. An activity schedule with timeFrom and timeTo both equal to 00:00 indicates a whole-day event.

parameters.description: First date in the activity search range, in yyyymmdd format. If either fromdate or todate is omitted, today's activity is returned.
parameters.name: fromdate

parameters.description: Last date in the activity search range, in yyyymmdd format. If either fromdate or todate is omitted, today's activity is returned.
parameters.name: todate

parameters.description: Filter by activity type. Omitted means all activity types.
parameters.name: activity

parameters.description: Filter by licence type. Omitted means all licence types.
parameters.name: licence

parameters.description: Activity charitable status: 1 returns charitable activities; 0 returns non-charitable activities. Omitted returns both.
parameters.name: charitable

parameters.description: Sort order criterion. Defaults to date.
parameters.name: orderby

parameters.description: Number of items requested per page. Defaults to 10. If greater than 100, at most 100 records are returned for each request.
parameters.name: itemperpage

parameters.description: Page to return based on itemperpage. Defaults to the first page.
parameters.name: page

200.description: JSON response containing search metadata and matching activities. The field dictionary describes the data elements; exact JSON nesting and wire representation are not specified by the retained documentation.

get.description: Searches fund-raising activities using the same documented query parameters and behavior as the JSON resource. An activity schedule with timeFrom and timeTo both equal to 00:00 indicates a whole-day event.

schema.description: XML payload; the complete XML structure is not established by the available field dictionary.

200.description: XML response containing search metadata and matching activities. The dictionary identifies XML-only elements including activity, subSchedule, and remark; no XML schema body was available to specify its complete structure.
